translations.web: I will judge you, as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
translations.bsb: And I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and those who shed blood; so I will bring upon you the wrath of your bloodshed and jealousy.
